title: An Interview With Roblox CEO David Baszucki About Aggregating Play
author: Ben Thompson
description: An interview with Roblox CEO David Baszucki about how AI is transforming game creation, and why that opens up huge opportunities to both enable developers and make Roblox both an Aggregator and a platform.
summary: Listen to this post: Good morning, This week’s Stratechery Interview is with Roblox CEO David Baszucki . I’ve interviewed Baszucki twice, in February 2022 , and November 2023 .
takeaways: We also touch on advertising — the natural Aggregator business model — and whether Baszucki still thinks he is building the metaverse.
But to go back to 2023, you called AI then, “a super paintbrush and a super 3D modeler, rather than a full replacement” — Is that still how you’re thinking about AI?
One, there’s various ways humans can augment with AI on Roblox, they can use MCP , which is like plugging in a model, they can use the Roblox AI assistant to help build.
